Name: Login
Desc: User enters credentials to access the system.

Name: Logout
Desc: User terminates active session securely.

Name: Forgot Password
Desc: User requests password reset via email.

Name: Reset Password
Desc: User sets a new password using valid reset token.

Name: View Profile
Desc: User views personal account information.

Name: Update Profile
Desc: User updates editable profile fields.

Name: Change Password
Desc: User changes current password after authentication.

Name: Send Account Credentials
Desc: Admin sends generated username/password to user email.

Name: Submit Tenant Registration
Desc: Guest submits registration form to open a center.

Name: Review Tenant Registration
Desc: SystemAdmin reviews pending tenant registration request.

Name: Approve Tenant Registration
Desc: SystemAdmin approves request to create tenant.

Name: Reject Tenant Registration
Desc: SystemAdmin rejects request with reason.

Name: Manage Centers
Desc: SystemAdmin manages center status and center list.

Name: Manage Service Plans
Desc: SystemAdmin creates/updates/deletes subscription plans.

Name: Submit Package Change Request
Desc: CenterAdmin submits upgrade/downgrade/renew request.

Name: Review Package Change Request
Desc: SystemAdmin reviews package change request.

Name: Approve Package Change Request
Desc: SystemAdmin approves request and triggers next billing flow.

Name: Reject Package Change Request
Desc: SystemAdmin rejects package change request with reason.

Name: Cancel / Terminate Subscription
Desc: SystemAdmin cancels the active subscription of a tenant.

Name: Pay Subscription by Cash
Desc: Center pays subscription invoice via cash confirmation flow.

Name: Pay Subscription by VNPay
Desc: Center pays subscription invoice via VNPay gateway.

Name: Submit Enrollment Request (Guest)
Desc: Guest submits student enrollment request to center.

Name: Submit Enrollment Request (Student)
Desc: Existing student submits self-enrollment request for class.

Name: Review Enrollment Request
Desc: CenterAdmin reviews incoming enrollment requests.

Name: Approve Enrollment Request
Desc: CenterAdmin approves request and creates/links student profile.

Name: Reject Enrollment Request
Desc: CenterAdmin rejects request and records rejection reason.

Name: Manage Students
Desc: CenterAdmin performs CRUD for student profiles.

Name: Manage Teachers
Desc: CenterAdmin performs CRUD for teacher profiles.

Name: Manage Assistants/Parents
Desc: CenterAdmin performs CRUD for assistant and parent profiles.

Name: Create Subject
Desc: CenterAdmin creates a new subject.

Name: Manage Subjects
Desc: CenterAdmin manages subject catalog.

Name: Manage Rooms
Desc: CenterAdmin manages classroom/room resources.

Name: Create Class
Desc: CenterAdmin creates class with schedule and constraints.

Name: Edit Class (Not Started)
Desc: CenterAdmin edits all class fields before class starts.

Name: Edit Class (Started)
Desc: CenterAdmin edits class with locked startDate and tuition fields.

Name: Edit Class (Ended)
Desc: System blocks class editing after class has ended.

Name: Assign & Import Teacher/Students to Class
Desc: CenterAdmin assigns teachers and students to class manually or imports students from Excel.

Name: Mark Attendance (Bulk)
Desc: Teacher/Assistant marks attendance in bulk per session.

Name: Mark Attendance (Quick)
Desc: Teacher/Assistant quickly marks attendance status.

Name: Update Attendance
Desc: Teacher/Assistant updates attendance within allowed rule window.

Name: Submit Attendance Modification Request
Desc: Teacher submits request to modify locked attendance records.

Name: Review Attendance Modification Request
Desc: CenterAdmin reviews and approves/rejects attendance modification request on the same screen.

Name: Create Assignment
Desc: Teacher creates assignment for class/session.

Name: Update Assignment
Desc: Teacher updates assignment details.

Name: Import Assignment
Desc: Teacher imports assignment from another session/template.

Name: Submit Assignment
Desc: Student submits assignment files/content.

Name: Update Submission
Desc: Student updates submission before deadline/rules.

Name: Grade Submission
Desc: Teacher/Assistant grades student submission.

Name: Publish Grade
Desc: Teacher publishes graded result to students/parents.

Name: Publish All Grades
Desc: Teacher publishes all grades for an assignment.

Name: Reset Submission
Desc: Teacher resets submission status for re-submission.

Name: Manage Lesson Materials
Desc: Teacher uploads lesson materials for a class; students and parents can view uploaded materials.

Name: Generate Tuition Invoice
Desc: CenterAdmin generates tuition invoice for student/class period.

Name: Generate Batch Tuition Invoices
Desc: CenterAdmin generates invoices in batch.

Name: View Outstanding Invoices
Desc: Parent/Student views unpaid tuition invoices.

Name: Create Family Invoice
Desc: Parent groups multiple child invoices into one family invoice.

Name: Lock Invoice by Month
Desc: CenterAdmin locks invoice editing for a specific month to finalize monthly accounting.

Name: Cancel Tuition Invoice
Desc: CenterAdmin cancels a generated tuition invoice.

Name: Move Paid Invoices to History
Desc: System moves paid invoices from active list to transaction history.

Name: Pay Family Invoice
Desc: Parent pays grouped family invoice.

Name: Pay Single Invoice by VNPay
Desc: Parent/Student pays individual invoice via VNPay.

Name: Confirm Cash Payment
Desc: CenterAdmin confirms cash payment for tuition invoice.

Name: Submit Refund Request
Desc: Parent/Center submits refund request for paid transaction.

Name: Approve Refund Request
Desc: SystemAdmin approves refund and updates related transactions.

Name: Reject Refund Request
Desc: SystemAdmin rejects refund request with reason.

Name: Send System Notification
Desc: System sends event-based notifications to users including automated payment reminders.

Name: View Notifications
Desc: User views notification inbox and read status.

Name: Send Zalo OA Notification
Desc: Admin/System sends notification through Zalo OA integration.

Name: Submit Support Request
Desc: User creates support ticket to center/system admin.

Name: Process Support Request
Desc: Admin handles, updates, and resolves support ticket.

Name: View Dashboard & Reports
Desc: Admin/Teacher views operational and performance reports.

Name: View Attendance Report
Desc: Teacher/CenterAdmin views detailed attendance report by class or session.

Name: Manage Center Public Profile
Desc: CenterAdmin manages public profile information of center.

Name: Manage Center Media
Desc: CenterAdmin manages hero images, gallery, highlights, and staff media.

Name: Manage Integration Settings
Desc: CenterAdmin configures external integrations including Zalo OA and VNPay payment gateway.
